title: Effect of angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibition and angiotensin II receptor blockers on cardiac angiotensin-converting enzyme 2
authors: Ferrario CM, Jessup J, Chappell MC, Averill DB, Brosnihan KB, Tallant EA, et al.
population: Lewis rats given vehicle, lisinopril, losartan or both in drinking water
funder: not read: the publisher page is not accessible and the PubMed abstract carries no funding statement.
result: With equivalent falls in blood pressure, lisinopril raised plasma angiotensin-(1-7) 1.8-fold, lowered plasma angiotensin II and raised cardiac ACE2 mRNA without raising cardiac ACE2 activity; losartan raised plasma angiotensin II and angiotensin-(1-7), cardiac ACE2 mRNA and cardiac ACE2 activity, and cardiac tissue angiotensin II and angiotensin-(1-7). The combination raised cardiac ACE2 activity but not mRNA.
